title: Mining assistance

detail.raise: The charge is under the green window and no longer climbing.
detail.holdRising: The charge is climbing towards the green window.
detail.holdWindow: The charge is in the green window.
detail.holdNoWindow: No green window found: nothing to aim for.
detail.lower: The charge is nearing the top of the green window.
detail.cut: The charge is going into overcharge.

acted.notFocused: Nothing sent: Star Citizen is not the active window.

waiting: Turn the reading on and switch to mining mode: the advice shows here.

screen.start: Read the charge gauge on screen
screen.calibrateHint: Draw the box around the "Charge level" arc
screen.setup: In mining mode, calibrate by drawing a box around the whole "Charge level" arc, from its bottom to the top of the red block. Keep the same camera position afterwards.
screen.calibrationFound: Box saved: the gauge reads in it.
screen.calibrationEmpty: Box saved, but neither the green window nor the charge reads in it. Calibrate in mining mode, with the arc in plain view.
screen.tooSmall: Box too small: draw it around the whole arc.
screen.unreadable: Gauge not found: not in mining mode, or something covers the box, this window included.

auto.label: Automatic mode
auto.warning: The automatic mode turns the wheel and clicks for you. Cloud Imperium's terms forbid macros and automation: use it at your own risk, your account may be sanctioned.
auto.focus: Nothing is sent unless Star Citizen is the active window. The laser is cut with one click, once, then nothing until the bar drops.
